gaps.sentence: She goes to ___ school by bus every morning.
gaps.explanation: 'Go to school/work/bed/church' (as participant) takes no article.

gaps.sentence: This is ___ second time you've been late this week.
He was offered ___ job in the human resources department.
gaps.explanation: 'A job' — first mention of one of many possible jobs. Note: 'in human resources' takes no article.

gaps.sentence: ___ rich should do more to help the poor.

gaps.sentence: We had ___ wonderful time in Prague.

gaps.sentence: The tour included ___ visit to the British Museum.
